content: lm-evaluation-harness CI structure (reference for benchmark repos): separate GitHub Actions workflows — linters job (pre-commit with ruff, 5min timeout), CPU unit-tests job (Python version matrix 3.9-3.11, pytest -n=auto, HF cache), and a path-filtered 'new_tasks' workflow (tj-actions/changed-files on lm_eval/tasks/**) running pytest tests/test_tasks.py which validates task configs (dataset loads, doc_to_text works, choices well-formed). DummyLM mock model lets CI exercise the full eval pipeline without GPU/weights/internet. tests/testdata/ holds expected outputs for regression testing.
